tools.name: discover
tools.description: Browse or filter the Discover index across spot tokens, tokenised stocks, perps and prediction markets; each row carries its venues, chains, outcomes and 24h stats. Filter by kind, venue, chain, class, tag or feed; sort by volume_24h, change_24h, market_cap, trending, ends_soon and more; page with c

tools.name: discover_categories
tools.description: List the Discover categories (prediction-market tags and their slugs) usable as discover's `tag` filter.

tools.name: get_perp_candles
tools.description: Hyperliquid perp candles for one coin as parallel arrays t/o/h/l/c/v. `coin` is the bare Hyperliquid coin (BTC, not BTC-PERP; HIP-3 coins are dex-prefixed, e.g. xyz:NVDA). `interval` sets the bar size (default 1h). `from`/`to` are unix MILLISECONDS (default the last 7 days); returned `t` is unix sec

tools.name: get_prediction_event
tools.description: One Polymarket event (all its outcomes) by event slug, event id, market slug or condition_id: each outcome's price, bid/ask and price history, plus live game state for sports. Prices are YES probabilities 0..1. `interval` is the history's lookback window (1h, 6h, 1d, 1w, 1m, max), not a bar size; ke

tools.name: get_syndicate
tools.description: One syndicate by id: its public page (name, pitch, operators, terms, members) under `syndicate` and its book (holdings, closed positions, balance curve) under `book`.

tools.name: get_token
tools.description: One token by chain and contract address: identity, mark price, liquidity and listings under `token`; per-window price change and 24h trading activity (volume, buys, sells, traders) under `stats`.

tools.name: get_token_candles
tools.description: OHLCV candles for one token by chain slug and contract address. `tf` sets the resolution; `from`/`to` are unix SECONDS. Always pass tf and from: with no window the answer runs to over a thousand bars. Use a coarse tf (60, 1D) for long windows.

tools.name: get_trader
tools.description: A trader's public profile by handle: user id, bio, avatar, follower and following counts, join date. Private and followers-only profiles answer not found.

tools.name: get_trader_activity
tools.description: A public trader's ledger activity by handle, newest first: swaps, deposits, withdrawals, transfers and fees. Narrow with `filter`, page with `cursor`.

tools.name: get_trader_portfolio
tools.description: A public trader's book by handle: open holdings and perps with value and PnL, closed positions, cash, realized PnL and the balance curve. Dust is hidden unless include_dust is true.

tools.name: leaderboard
tools.description: The points leaderboard's top rows: rank, handle, score and referrals. Points, not trading performance; use list_traders for PnL.

tools.name: list_perp_markets
tools.description: Raw Hyperliquid metaAndAssetCtxs (large): a universe array and a per-asset context array, parallel and joined by index, delisted coins included. Funding is the hourly rate as a fraction; open interest is in coin units. Use only for raw funding; screen perps with discover kind=perp.

tools.name: list_syndicates
tools.description: Browse public syndicates (shared trading books run by operators), newest first: id, name, pitch, emblem, status, operators and member count. Page with `cursor`.

tools.name: list_traders
tools.description: The trading ranking: public traders by realized PnL, return or hit rate over a rolling window, with open value and balance per row. Few traders qualify; raise min_sales (default 5) to drop lucky one-sale records, and always show each row's `sales` beside its rank.

tools.name: search_assets
tools.description: Search everything by text: tokens, perps, prediction markets and traders matching a ticker, name, address or handle. Start here to turn a name into the chain+address, coin or condition_id the other tools take. `limit` caps token hits only. Names are often ambiguous (many TRUMPs): pick by kind and li
